title: Why Making A Penny Costs More Than It's Worth
hook: Every penny made since 2006 has cost more than a cent.
closing: Data refuses to pick up pennies off the ground.
question: Do you still bother picking up pennies?

segments.say: Every US penny has cost more to make since 2006 -- now 3.69 cents each.
In 2024 alone, making pennies cost taxpayers $118 million, more than they were worth.
